feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1079 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: California Meal & Rest Break Premium Checker — free timecard audit
entry.summary: Free California meal and rest break premium pay checker for restaurants, retail and any hourly employer. Paste timecards, find late, short and missed meal periods and rest break shortfalls, and total the one-hour premium owed per workday. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Courier Van Route Profit Calculator — true profit per route, per hour and per stop
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent delivery van contractors. Enter route pay, stops, packages, miles, fuel, van payment, insurance and tax set-aside; it shows true profit per route, per hour and per stop, break-even stops, the lowest route pay that hits your hourly target, and compares two route offers. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Event Rental Inventory Payback Calculator — which chairs, tables and linens to buy next
entry.summary: Free calculator for party and event rental companies. Enter what each item costs, what a rental earns, how often it goes out, handling, breakage and storage; it ranks your inventory by return, shows payback and the lowest price per item. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: FLSA Regular-Rate Overtime Audit — free payroll check
entry.summary: Free FLSA regular rate of pay and overtime audit for restaurants, retailers, staffing agencies and bookkeepers. Paste payroll rows, see the regular rate with bonuses and shift differentials, the half-time premium owed, back pay and lookback exposure. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Franchise Item 19 Reality Check — what the earnings claim leaves out
entry.summary: Free franchise Item 19 reality check. Enter the earnings tiers from a franchise disclosure document and see owner earnings after royalty and ad fund, payback, the average versus the median, and how many units fall below your salary target. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Golf Simulator Bay Profit Calculator — monthly profit, payback and break-even utilization
entry.summary: Free calculator for indoor golf simulator lounges and bay-rental venues. Enter bays, peak and off-peak rates, utilization, members, food and drink, rent and staff; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback on the build, break-even utilization, the lowest rates for your target margin, and compares a second scenario. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Kids Birthday Party Package Profit Calculator — true profit, margin and lowest price per party
entry.summary: Free calculator for trampoline parks, bounce gyms, play cafes and family entertainment centers. Enter the package price, children, party length, hosts, food and goodie cost, card fees, the open-play revenue given up and yearly rent; it shows true profit per party, profit per room hour and the lowest package price for your margin. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Lawn Aeration and Overseeding Bid Calculator — true profit, margin and lowest quote per job
entry.summary: Free calculator for lawn-care operators pricing core aeration and overseeding. Enter lot size, beds and hardscape, aerator passes and speed, seed and fertilizer rates, crew hours, truck miles and your machine cost; it shows true profit per job, margin, profit per crew hour, the lowest quote that hits your target margin, price per 1,000 sq ft, break-even jobs a season, and compares two jobs. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Node Version Drift Check — Do Your package.json, .nvmrc, Dockerfile and CI Agree on Node.js?
entry.summary: Paste package.json, .nvmrc, .tool-versions, a Dockerfile and a GitHub Actions workflow and see whether your Node.js versions drifted: a pin that breaks engines.node, majors that disagree across files, end-of-life Node.js, or an unbounded engines range. Free, deterministic, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Party Bus Charter Profit Calculator — true profit, margin and lowest quote per charter
entry.summary: Free calculator for party bus, limo and shuttle charter operators. Enter the charter price, hours and minimum, driver and deadhead time, miles, fuel, vehicle cost and yearly overhead; it shows true profit per charter, profit per vehicle hour and the lowest quote for your margin. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Pilot Car Escort Run Profit Calculator — true profit, margin and lowest quote per run
entry.summary: Free calculator for pilot car and oversize-load escort operators. Enter your quote (flat, day rate or per loaded mile), minimum charge, loaded and deadhead miles, driver hours, fuel, per diem and yearly overhead; it shows true profit per run, profit per driver hour and the lowest quote for your margin. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Tent Rental Job Profit Calculator — true profit, margin and lowest quote per job
entry.summary: Free calculator for tent and party rental companies. Enter the rental price, delivery fee, crew hours, truck miles, tent cost and yearly overhead; it shows true profit per job, margin, profit per crew hour, the lowest quote that hits your target margin, how many rentals a tent needs to pay for itself, and compares two jobs. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Weekly Staff Schedule Maker — free employee schedule generator for restaurants and shops
entry.summary: Free weekly staff schedule maker. List your people, roles, hour limits and days off plus the shifts to cover, and get a fair schedule that respects rest between shifts, with open shifts explained, a labor cost estimate and CSV and text exports. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Amusement Route Location Calculator — is each arcade, pool table or claw machine location worth the drive?
entry.summary: Free calculator for coin-op route operators. Enter each location's weekly take, commission, visits and miles; it shows profit per route hour, the weekly take you need, and the highest commission you can pay and still earn your target. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Barbershop Chair Profit Calculator — Haircut Price, Booth Rent vs Commission
entry.summary: Free barbershop calculator: enter haircut, beard and combo prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per cut and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even cuts per week and whether to rent the chair or employ a barber. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Bed Bug Heat Treatment Bid Calculator — Price Per Job and Per Square Foot
entry.summary: Free bed bug heat treatment bid calculator: enter the floor area, clutter, heaters, crew, fuel and callback rate, and get a price, a price per square foot and a comparison with a chemical programme. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Bike Shop Repair Profit Calculator — Job Price, Break-Even, Bench Hours
entry.summary: Free bike repair shop calculator: enter job prices, bench minutes, materials, technician pay, tools and rent, and see profit per job and per bench hour, break-even volume and the plan result. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Boat Rental Fleet Profit Calculator — Rent Direct, List or Charter
entry.summary: Free boat, jet ski and pontoon rental calculator: enter hourly, half-day and full-day prices, fuel and wear, dock and insurance, a short season and a weather cancellation rate, and see profit per rental and per boat hour, break-even rentals per week and whether to rent direct, list on a marketplace or run captained charters. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Braiding Studio Profit Calculator — Braiding appointment Price, Booth Rent vs Commission
entry.summary: Free braiding studio calculator: enter knotless, cornrow and twist prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per style and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even styles per week and whether to rent the chair or employ a braider. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Car Lease Deal Checker — money factor to APR, markup and lease vs buy
entry.summary: Free car lease calculator. Turn a money factor into APR, find the money factor hiding in a quoted payment, price dealer markup in dollars, and compare leasing with buying. Private, in your browser, nothing uploaded.
